items.title: VisionPI — Textile Defect Detection
items.description: Industrial vision system using YOLOv11 to detect and classify fabric defects in real time.
items.descriptionLong:
End-to-end quality-control system powered by computer vision. The detection and segmentation model is trained with YOLOv11 to recognize up to 8 fabric defect types (hook, missing, knot, burn, retention, dirt, weave, and warp) on images and live video.

On the edge, an inference service optimized for Raspberry Pi 5 runs YOLO models with NCNN support, captures from USB/CSI cameras, and exposes a local REST API backed by SQLite. Detections are queried remotely, classified as failure/no-failure, and stored only after validation.

The central backend, built with FastAPI and MySQL, manages Raspberry Pi devices, JWT authentication via HTTP-only cookies, intelligent inference classification, and advanced statistics. The admin panel, developed with React 18, TypeScript, and Vite, provides a real-time dashboard, inference management, a labeling system, device monitoring, and light/dark theme support.

The architecture connects the production floor (edge), management backend, and web panel, aimed at reducing textile defects and tracking every classification.

items.title: Steam Leak Detection — Industrial Vision OPC UA
items.description: PoC for detecting copper-tinted steam/smoke leaks using computer vision, PLC via OPC UA, and a web dashboard.
items.descriptionLong:
Industrial proof of concept that detects steam/copper-tinted smoke leaks in real time by combining computer vision and PLC integration. The CPU-optimized vision pipeline uses MOG2 background subtraction and HSV filtering over an RTSP stream to measure leak magnitude.

The Flask backend serves as the central engine: it runs the OpenCV pipeline, serves an ultra-low-latency MJPEG stream, pushes live telemetry via Server-Sent Events, writes metrics to SQL Server, and records evidence clips to disk. Through OPC UA, it sends the vapor pixel count and a watchdog heartbeat to the PLC for integration with SCADA or alarm systems.

The dashboard, built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS, includes a live monitor, historical charts, an evidence gallery, and a visual hot-calibration tool (HSV, ROI, and threshold) that tunes the detector without restarting the service.

The full stack can be launched with Docker Compose and includes OPC UA PLC and RTSP camera simulators for development without physical hardware.

items.title: Kaizen Corporate Website
items.description: Kaizen Software corporate site: services, portfolio, team, and contact.
items.descriptionLong:
Corporate website for Kaizen Software built as a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA. Architecture splits pages by domain (home, services, portfolio, about, team, contact) with lazy-loaded heavy sections and reusable components on Radix UI and Tailwind.

Full i18n (Spanish and English), light/dark/system theme, filterable portfolio with a detail modal, and a contact form with validation and bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile). SEO uses metadata, sitemap, and semantic structure aimed at B2B conversion without hurting mobile performance.

items.title: Bingo593 Interactive Bingo Platform
items.description: Live bingo with digital cards, agent network, and bank-transfer payments.
items.descriptionLong:
Live bingo platform on Next.js (App Router) with PostgreSQL and Prisma. Core domain models games with states (draft, live, finished), price per card, streaming URL, winner, and automatic claim windows.

Operationally it covers digital card sales and assignment, an agent hierarchy with referral codes, commissions, withdrawal requests, and bank-transfer payment review. Files (receipts, assets) go to AWS S3; auth and roles separate players, agents, and admins with module-scoped permissions.

items.title: Lexcard Educational Management System
items.description: Education platform with tests, flashcards, and admin panel (private access).
items.descriptionLong:
Multi-tenant learning platform for law and medical students. Main app uses Next.js 16 (App Router), Prisma, MySQL, NextAuth v5, and shadcn/ui: tests with multiple question types, flashcards with progress tracking, e-books by category, and interactive clinical cases.

The admin panel (React + Vite) manages users, content, categories, and payments. Monetization uses subscription plans via Flow.cl; gamification (rankings, badges, referrals), email verification, and password recovery via SMTP. Private project: no public demo in the portfolio.

items.title: MedLink - Medical Dashboard
items.description: Web and mobile clinic management: appointments, patients, records, and alerts.
items.descriptionLong:
Full-stack clinic suite deployed at medlink.kaizensoftware.com.ec. Three layers: Next.js web panel for staff, modular NestJS API (TypeORM, DTOs, JWT and role guards), and a Flutter app with Riverpod for patients and doctors.

Features include scheduling and appointments with states, patient and doctor profiles, clinical history, prescriptions, messaging, reviews, Stripe payments, S3 uploads, BullMQ/Redis queues, transactional email, and Firebase push notifications. Built for day-to-day clinic operations with clear doctor vs. patient roles.

items.title: TikTok Suite — Live, TTS & Audio
items.description: TikTok Live monorepo: web dashboard, API, mobile app, and TTS voice generation.
items.descriptionLong:
pnpm + Turbo monorepo (tiktok-suite v2): NestJS 11 API, Next.js 16 dashboard, React Native 0.79 app, plus a shared package with types and Zod schemas. Local infra uses PostgreSQL and Redis; each app is Docker-buildable.

Core domain is TikTok Live: stream connection, control panel, and Text-to-Speech generation with paginated per-user history and a global admin view. JWT/OAuth auth, cloud storage, and boundary validation (class-validator on the API, Zod in shared). The mobile app exposes Live and TTS screens with toggles and voice customization.

items.title: Corazón de Diamante
items.description: MLM e-commerce with admin panel, bonus network, orders, and documented REST API.
items.descriptionLong:
E-commerce and network-marketing stack for Corazón de Diamante. Admin panel in React + Vite + TypeScript: dashboard metrics (ApexCharts), CRUD for users, products, orders, events, packages, and ranks; network visualization with ReactFlow and maps with Leaflet.

Compensation engine includes 3×3 matrix, network, repurchase, and infinity bonuses, plus wallet and real-time notifications via Socket.io. The Node.js API (api-corazon) centralizes auth, role-based authorization, business rules, and Swagger docs for integrations and the desktop front end.

items.title: CopyXpress
items.description: Flutter app, API, and web admin panel for stationery and print orders by branch.
items.descriptionLong:
CopyXpress chain: Flutter consumer app and Express + Sequelize backend on MySQL. The app browses the catalog, configures print jobs (types, finishes, branch), builds a cart, picks delivery, and pays via bank transfer, Payphone, or PagoMedios; uses local SQLite, OneSignal, and per-branch app versioning.

The API models branches, products, categories, orders, billing, devices, and notifications. The React/Vite panel gives each branch tools to process orders, ads, and configurable payment methods without redeploying the mobile app.

items.title: Person Re-Identification
items.description: ESPE thesis: person re-ID with YOLOv8, OpenCV, and GPU processing.
items.descriptionLong:
ESPE graduation work on person re-identification in surveillance video. Python pipeline: frame capture, detection with YOLOv8 exported to ONNX, OpenCV processing, and CUDA multiprocessing to keep up with test sequences.

Combines biometric and soft-biometric cues (clothing, context) to link identities across cameras or shots. Repository includes training/inference scripts and evaluation matrices; formal thesis is in the ESPE institutional repository.

items.title: Personal Data Query API
items.description: Node.js API with Playwright for queries on Ecuadorian public portals.
items.descriptionLong:
Node.js + Express REST API wrapping automated scraping with Playwright (headless Chromium). Each integration targets a public Ecuadorian portal—for example customs quotas (Aduana), company registry (Supercías), property tax (predial), and ELEPCO queries—returning normalized JSON from ID or other inputs.

Design reuses a browser instance, per-query timeouts, page cleanup, and structured error responses so external systems avoid manual RPA. Useful as an integration layer when no stable official API exists.

items.title: Photography & Illustration Service
items.description: Express + Handlebars website for a photography and illustration portfolio.
items.descriptionLong:
Photography and illustration services showcase (DWAP2 academic project). Express serves Handlebars views with partials (header, footer, sections) and static assets under /public; simple routes for home and modular product and contact content.

Demonstrates lightweight server-rendered templates, view organization, and responsive CSS without a SPA framework. Runs on Node with env-based port configuration.

items.title: Kaizen Novel
items.description: Flutter novel app with Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Cloud Functions.
items.descriptionLong:
Light-novel reader and publisher. Flutter client (Android) with route-based navigation, local state, and multi-language catalog and reading. Backend is Firebase Cloud Functions: auth, Firestore rules, and functions to register works, metadata, and sync progress across devices.

Decoupled architecture across two repos (mobile front end and functions). Firestore is the catalog source of truth; functions hold logic that must not live on the client for security and consistency.
